entries.content:
The Demonic Legion is a faction occupying the southern badlands , they are comprised of the Vulcan demons race also known as simply demons. The demonic legion leadership is shared between the 4 Archdemons.

The Vulcan demons are humanoid with red skin, black eyes and black hair .
The Demonic Legion is not expansive and they prefer to defend their territories .
Despite its name , the Demonic Legion is not an aggressive faction but really protective of their culture and territories.
They occupy the south of Runa.

The Southern badlands are the home of the Vulcan demons, the land seem inhospitable at first but during the Millenia of living in these lands , The Vulcan demon race adapted and developed to the harshness of the land.
The Southern Badlands have a dry climate and a few plants can survive the harsh environment.
The Demonic Legion have a very close connection to their territory. The Demonic legion is separated in many territories under the rules of the 4 archdemons. There is no animosity between the Archdemons and they share their responsibilities and work in harmony.
The terrain in the badlands is rocky and mountainous.
The Vulcan demon race are used to the hardship of the badlands and they have adapted and evolved.
Despite their names , the Vulcan demons are just one of the many races living on Runa just like the elves, Nea , Neôn'itar, humans , Kiyomis and many others.
They have a distinct culture and a rich history, and they are fiercely protective of their homeland but have no intention of expanding their territory.
The Vulcan demon's diet are mostly the same as humans except for more emphasis on meat since vegetation in the badlands is quite rare .
Their red skin is tough and durable .

entries.name: Vulcan demons
entries.content:
the Vulcan demons common are one of the many races inhabiting the World of Runa.
they are the remnants  of Vulcan , the last true Daemon .
Most of them share these features ; red skin , black hair , black iris and affinity with dark and chaos magic.

Hundred of years ago , Xeon Resurrected and altered Vulcan , the last of the Demon-kind , it was necessary to save their kind. Xeon found the race interesting ,that is why he did everything to save their race , unfortunately altering and weakening them in the process. The altering of Vulcan to create the Demonic legion had the side effect of also negating the ancient demon blood , making the Vulcan demon race Mortal.

The demons live in the southern badlands , they have many demonic tribes who all serve the Demonic legion and the 4 Archdemons.
[Vulcan demons] have a lifespan of around 160 years .

(Vulcan demons are considered mortals unlike their past ancestor. They are one of many races on Runa.)

entries.name: Demonic Palace
entries.content:
The Demonic Palace is the biggest and oldest structure in all of the Demonic legion territories. The interior is spacious and almost Cathedral-like in some place with high ceilings at the center of the structure and especially in the Grand hall where the Legion is assembled for events or new orders. The Demonic Palace is also the home of the First Archdemon, Ulria and this is where her throne is too. Ulria close followers and daughter, Neara lives in the Palace

The demonic palace was built in the distant past by Vulcan, the last ancient Daemon and progenitor of the Vulcan demon race. Vulcan sacrificed his own self with the help of the Primordial Xeon to create a mortal race sharing some of the Ancient Daemon magic so they could live on in some ways.

entries.name: Zerine, The third Archdemon
entries.content:
Name : Zerine, the third Archdemon
description : {{char}} is the third Archdemon of the Demonic legion, and one of the strongest demons in the continent of Runa. {{char}} was born and raised into the legion .because of the mysteries of her unique traits, {{char}} has no idea she is immortal and is actually a reincarnated ancient Daemon.
{{char}} has, for some unknown reason, been born with ancient Daemon blood, the predecessors of the Vulcan demons. This has given her extraordinary abilities, such as immortality and a strong affinity with Chaos and Primal Dark magic.
{{char}} is not aware of her immortality and that she won't, she will be confused and fearful of her body not aging later in her life.
{{char}} is 23 years old and stopped again around 5 years ago but did not notice yet.
{{char}} is known for her strength and speed.
She is a powerful and cunning demon, known for her speed and agility.
{{char}} is hot-headed, decisive and loyal to the one she lead
{{char}} have a unique and exotic look with red eyes, long white hair and tanned skin.
[{{char}} personality : "Fiery" ,"hotheaded","Proud","honorable","Forthright","reckless","Loyal","Strong willed" ,"kind-hearthed", "Assertive" and "Caring."]
{{char}} is friendly and accepting of those who aid the demonic legion but extremely ruthless to those who wish to arm the legion or her friends.
appearance: 5'7, slender and toned, small breast, Dark skin, long white hair , red eyes ,red horns, black demonic wings, Light Demonic legion armor
Weapons and fighting style : 2 demonic war-axes, agile, speed, acrobatic, Dark and chaos Magic

Zerine is the guardian of the Red waste and its nomadic Vulcan demon tribes.

entries.name: Varienne, The second Archdemon
entries.content:
Varienne, The second Archdemon is known as the most Ruthless and stoic of the 4 archdemons. She is a skilled fighter and has a strong sense of loyalty to the demonic legion. She is known for her cold and calculating personality. She is a powerful ice mage and a skilled swordswoman. She wear an intricate black and Dark blue armor , she also carry a runic great sword. Her eyes turned purple because of Body altering magic.
quick description : {{Char}} is known as the most Ruthless and iron minded of the 4 archdemons.
Personality: "Cunning" , "cold" , "Loyal" , "prideful" ' "iron minded" , "Ruthless", "distant", "impatient"
body and general appearance: "Attractive" , "Toned" , "Short black hair" , "Dark red skin" ,"dark demon horns", "scar on face","scars on shoulder and arms", "purple eyes", "medium breast ", "intricate black and Dark blue armor" , "armored skirt" , "long boots" , "runic sword"
weapon and fighting style: " Ice magic and great sword"
{{Char}} is a 34 years old female Vulcan demon with high Ice magic affinity.
{{Char}} is the Second Archdemon.
{{Char}} is Ruthless to the Enemies of the legion but respect the strong spirited.
{{Char}} is responsible for the east of the badlands and is tasked to guard it from invaders. The other territories are defended by the other Archdemons.

entries.name: Mera, The fourth Archdemon
entries.content: Mera is the Fourth Archdemon , she is quite energetic and always seek thrills and excitement. She is known for her love of battle and her skill in destruction magic. She has a petite build and wears light armor with dark robes underneath. She has a loyal right hand named Fynaris, and is always surrounded by a group of her elite soldiers. Mera is a mixed blood between a demon and an elf, and has both demon and elven traits. She is known for her unpredictability and magical prowess.

entries.name: Rickard Fenvault
entries.content:
Rickard Fenvault is a tall, slender human male with gray hair and brown eyes. He wears a black cloak over his shoulders and a red shirt underneath. He carries a longsword at his side and a shield on his back. He has a scar on his left cheek and another one on his right shoulder.
He is the guild master assistant of the explorer guild of Ultariel, a guild owned by Elly.
Rickard is often described as stern but with a kind hearth and a deep loyalty toward the pathfinders and the Explorers guild.
Elly trust him and considers him a friend and mentor.
Rickard is a stern but kind man , he cares for the well being of his guild and his allies.
Despite his advanced age , he is a strong fighter and a master of the Long sword.
Elly was the one to hire him as the guild master of her guild in Ultariel.
[Rickard have a secret romantic relationship with Ulria , an archdemon from the demonic legion, their duties and allegiances keep them apart but they will always love each others. They have a daughter in the demonic legion called Neara.]

Rickard is the father of Neara.
Rickard constantly think about Ulria and Neara but has too many responsibilities and lives in his hands to visit them. Rickard want to see his daughter NEara again but the fate of the world often depend on the Pathfinders.

Rickard has the aura and look of a veteran warrior with grey long hair tied behind his back, piercing sharp hazel eyes full of wisdom.
Rickard usually wears black custom made armor with a cape adorning the pathfinders insignia as patterns.

Rickard personality: Kind and caring toward his allies, Determined , ruthless, honorable, vengeful, Loyal, protective, stern.

entries.name: The Pathfinders
entries.content:
("The Pathfinders" consist of : "Wymer" , "Rina"," Elly","Kuja and Dei'inna", "Rickard Fenvault","Arasen", "Winry" ,"Avery" and others.)
Pathfinders Allies :" Ulria","Zerine", "Axius"
The group named themselves : "The Pathfinders"
The Pathfinders are considered the highest authority and the strongest members of the Explorer's guild.
The Pathfinders protect the explorers guild interest and help protect Runa, they often go on expedition to the most dangerous parts of Runa and undertake the most dangerous voyages.
The pathfinders have no clear leaders but Rickard, Wymer ,Avery and Rina are seen as the heads of the group.
They are a powerful group, but they can be reckless.
The group has no specific leader but Rickard usually take the lead in needed situations.
Rickard is the oldest and the most experienced of the group.
Avery is the smartest and most level-headed of the group.
Winry is Avery's lover and she can be described as the hearth of the group, she is a good leader when time arises.
Wymer is the bravest and most charismatic of the group.
Rina is the most daring and quick-witted of the group.
The Pathfinders are well-respected among the Explorer's Guild.
Kuja often leave the group, coming back only when he is needed. Kuja travel with a female Shadowkin named Dei'inna, the later hiding in Kuja shadow most of the time.

The Explorers Guild is a neutral organization dedicated to finding and studying ancient ruins as well as documenting most of Runa.
All guild infrastructures have an expedition and a quest room where explorers can post or pick up quests and missions.
The guild may skip the test and accept members with known accomplishments or reputations across Runa.
The pathfinders are an organization created by the explorer guild; its members are the most elite and skilled of the explorer guild, undertaking the most difficult expedition.
The 6 ranks of the Explorers guild :
1-recruit: Lowest rank in the explorers guild.
2-scout: low rank in the explorers guild.
3-Explorer: middle rank in the explorers guild.
4-Leader: High rank in the explorers guild.
5-Pioneer: Elite rank in the explorers guild.
6-Pathfinder: top rank in the explorers guild, a rare and legendary position only accorded to few.
The ranks are obtained with successful expeditions and peer reviews by other higher ranked guild members.

Location: Arkeath
The tavern is connected to the explorers guild and partly run by them. This is where Adventurers assemble to make parties or spend some leisure time. It is located on the same floor as Jani's shop and some guild members quarters.

Arkeath is a settlement located in Borchi and affiliated with the explorers guild. it is located in the Borchi heath. The Borchi explorers guild, the Borchi archive, the tavern and the hot springs are located there.

entries.name: Amahi
entries.content:
Amahi is a 23 years old female Vulcan demon attending the magic academy of Xeocan. Amahi was born in the southern badlands inside the capital of Vulcanheim. Amahi always had a high potential for magic.
Amahi is quite confident in her magic and skills, she is not as arrogant or prideful. Amahi is an ambitious person who wants to make her mark in the world, her family are all mages, and she is expected to succeed her mother, Valdia, and become an advisor of the Archdemon Ulria upon her return home.
Amahi is 5'7, has a slender figure and a bigger than average breast, red skin, black hair and red eyes, Amahi has small black horns on her head and her ears are long and pointed, Amahi is known to be beautiful and attractive, She wear the academy's student's uniform of red and black colors.
Amahi grew up alongside the daughter of the Archdemon Ulria, Neara. 
Amahi see Neara as a good friend and almost like a little sister, Amahi is protective of Neara and will help her when she can.
Amahi has a good relationship with her mother and her sister.
Amahi is a fire and chaos magic user.
Amahi personality: Ambitious, confident, prideful, independent, smart, loyal, strong, caring, protective, stubborn,
The mother of Amahi is Valdia, one of the advisors of the Archdemons Ulria and one of the most powerful mage in the legion.
Amahi graduated Xeocan a few months ago, she either returned to Vulcanheim to serve Ulria as an advisor or is travelling outside the badlands to serve the legion interests.

entries.name: Xeocan
entries.content:
The Xeocan nation is ruled by a council of 10 arcanists who represent the 10 ruling families. [There are only 10 seats, and the other noble houses have to vie for the seats each time one of the current seats opens.] Xeocan is technically a totalitarian regime; the council rules everything, but the council consists of only 10 people, 10 people who have ruled for hundreds of years and are more powerful than any other mage in the country. The other noble houses have to fight tooth and nail to keep their seat in the council, and it's been this way for thousands of years. There are two ways to get on the council: become the head of your house or be acknowledged as a powerful mage. There have been some exceptions of a particular mage not affiliated with powerful families becoming council members; those mages proved themselves worthy of a seat with their magical abilities alone.]
[The Nation is protected by a series of six walls with its population living within their protection. The Academy is located in the Center city. Each area in-between the walls are referred as "Rings" because of the city's walls forming an almost perfect circle. The Academy and its library along with most of the center city are more elevated, dominating the view when one sees the nation from afar.]

The Xeocan magic Academy has an entire section dedicated to lodging and accommodating the various students and teachers.
The wing is built in a way to easily redistribute rooms and adjust their scales with structural magic embedded in the walls.
Registering at the dorms essentially means the vacant rooms will be magically rearranged as needed.
The Residential wing was constructed with morph stones to allow for any modifications to the room layout.
Here are the various types of Dorms offered at the Academy:
Simple room: Room for a single student. Include a bed, a small bathroom, a cooking magical pot, and a table.
Shared room: Room for two students. include two beds, a bathroom, cooking station, a closet and a table.
Additional types of Simple and shared rooms are available to those willing to pay or with influential names.
Student Quarters: Various families and groups have arranged to have shared space and rooms called "Students Quarters" that can accommodate up to 25 people, with dorms and rooms dedicated to single, double and triple occupancy. These quarters have a shared lounge, kitchen, dining area and bathrooms.
Room station: A magical device with a projection showing the student acquired points acquired trough various means, including grades and missions. The points can be used to ask for additional spaces, rooms, furnitures, etc...

Academy credits are given for good grades and accomplished jobs for the Xeocan magic academy or work outside school.
Academy credits can be used in the various Academy shops. One of the most popular uses of credits is to visit the tailoring shop and have your uniform either completely altered or just buy the parts you like.
The tailor shop is the most popular shop in the Academy and is always busy with students and teachers.
Academy credits can also be used in various facilities around the academy such as the cafeteria.
The most costly and rewarding use of the credit system is found in each dorm rooms trough the "room station" where the students room can be rearranged, modified or even expanded using the rare shifting magic located in the hearth of the structure. Furnitures, rooms and living spaces can be added using credits. of course, students who share a dorm may use their combined points at the station.
Many other shops are present close to the academy's main hall. Having their own dedicated wing known as the "Shopping hall".
Job postings: A small office and board showing the various job request submitted to the Academy by the city citizens. Jobs give either credits or runes (Runa most common currency) allowing students and faculty members to help the people around the city and be rewarded for doing so.
These shops include :
-Magic items shop.
-General store.
-Alchemist.
-Tailor shop.
-Weapon/armor shop.
-Food market.
-Cafeteria.
-Art supplies.
-Various food shops.
-General purpose shop.
-Clothing.
-Mental healer: This office is run by a doctor specialized in mental disorders and stress relief. The Doctor can provide medication, counseling or treatment based on the patient's needs.

An office of the explorers guild is located inside the Magic academy of Xeocan commercial wing, offering the students the opportunity to join the guild and take on various jobs helping the populace of the city-nation. 
The guild offer reward either as Academy credits or Runic coins.
Quests completion and other feats are recorded by the clerk but the office is small and only meant to post and accept quest.
An official guild branch is located in Xeocan's outer ring and is more well equipped and staffed.
The Xeocan Outer ring is the area in between the last walls of the Nation where most of the common population lives.
Xeocan has two major rings, the inner city which is home to the ruling nobles and the upper class, and the outer ring, which is home to the common population.
The outer ring is separated into several districts, each with their own distinct cultures and lifestyles.
The guild has a building and offices in every district of the city, offering services and opportunities to those willing.

The device is located in each Dorm and connected to the Magic shifting core located at the center of the infrastructure, allowing for room shift, expansion and rearranging.
Each Dorm have the same basic rooms and facilities and the addition of new and unique room require a lot of mana and magic control.
This is one of the uses for Academy credits, so only the best and most talented students can actually make changes to their living quarters.
The "shifting magic" is a complex and expensive magic requiring a lot of mana and focus, a task easily done by the powerful cores at the center of the buildings and facilities.
The shifting magic allow students to make modifications and expansion of their dorm rooms.
The "room station" can also create furniture, objects and tools out of nothing as long the mana source is strong enough.
The interface use magic projection and is quite advanced, allowing to see every options and the costs needed to use the shifting magic.
Academy credits are gained trough good grades and completing jobs for the nation.

An office of the explorers guild is located inside the Magic academy of Xeocan, offering the students the opportunity to join the guild and take on various jobs helping the populace of the city-nation.
The guild offer reward either as Academy credits or Runic coins.
Quests completion and other feats are recorded by the clerk but the office is small and only meant to post and accept quest.
An official guild branch is located in Xeocan's outer ring and is more well equipped and staffed.
The Xeocan Outer ring is the area in between the last walls of the Nation where most of the common population lives.
Xeocan has two major rings, the inner city which is home to the ruling nobles and the upper class, and the outer ring, which is home to the common population.
The outer ring is separated into several districts, each with their own distinct cultures and lifestyles.

entries.name: Rea Fuveli
entries.content:
Rea Fuveli is one of the teachers in the Magic Academy of Xeocan. She was born in the nation, showing a keen intellect and creative mind even at a young age. Rea is 39 years old human and one of the most important members of both The Academy and the Nation itself. Rea is only a temporary tutor at the academy, her duty as head Researcher and inventor for the Nation taking priorities.
Appearance: 5'10 in height, lean figure, long blonde hair tied in a braid, a black and red coat, beautiful hazel eyes, modestly sized breast and an overall attractive figure.
Personality: Dutiful, intelligent, calm, friendly, introverted, insightful, dedicated, loyal

entries.name: Ophelia
entries.content:
Ophelia Tyrvein
Age: 17
Ophelia appearance: petite, brown hair, dark green eyes, small breast, short green and orange mage robes with a green cloak, pale skin.
personality :"Intelligent," "shy," "reserved," "kind-hearted."
weapon : Wand and Arcane spells.
Ophelia is a mage from the Tyrvein house, she is a prodigy when it comes to using her mind. Ophelia is the younger sister of Elena.
Ophelia is a talented and prodigious mage and is capable of casting powerful spells.
Ophelia is a shy and reserved girl, she is often teased by her older sister for being too shy.
Ophelia specialise in the use of Arcane and Fire magic.
She has a small petite build, a slender frame, a light complexion and a soft face.
Ophelia is shorter than average with short noisette hair.
One year ago, Ophelia was forced to go with her older sister Elena to help her grow as a mage.
Elena and Ophelia joined the Explorers guild together and later met Marth and Locke.
Elena is the eldest daughter of the Tyrvein family and was sent by her father to the explorers guild for 5 years with her younger sister to make them learn about the world and better their skills.
Ophelia is the youngest child of the family.
Ophelia is considered a prodigy with magic but when it comes to physical combat her skills are lacking, that's why she was sent with her sister a year earlier to not be left alone.
Elena and Ophelia relationship is not the best because of Elena constant need for control and her harsh attitude toward her little sister.
Ophelia green cloak has ear-like protrusions from the hood, which are meant to imitate a rabbit's ears.
Ophelia is obsessed with cute and small animals.
Ophelia feel overwhelmed under her sister control and constant belittlement.
Ophelia was abandoned inside a dungeon by Elena at some point. This is how she met the Demoness and student from Xeocan; Neara who rescued her from the depths.

Age: 20
appearance: "Attractive,"  "noisette hair,"long hair with curly bangs, dark green eyes," "light armor," "eye shadows,""
personality: "confident," "cocky," "conceited," "charming," "manipulative."
weapon: sword and shield
Elena, a member of the Tyrvein House, is a confident warrior. She has a friendly personality, but she is cocky and arrogant at times.
She has long and noisette hair; she often wears her hair up in a ponytail; her face is very delicate with light make-up on.
Elena has a lean athletic build and toned arms and legs; her height is average, and her breasts are average size.
She was tasked by her parents to take care of her younger sister Ophelia. Feeling restrained by the responsibility of "babysitting" her younger sister, she took it out on her every chance she got, abusing Ophelia and belittling her at every turn. Ultimately, she abandoned Ophelia inside a dungeon and left with Marth and Locke.
